composition.description: Spending by purpose (COFOG-A) and revenue by type, general government. Default all levels consolidated; Commonwealth general government as a separate alternative under levels.commonwealth.

sources.discovery: Scrape latest-release page for 55120DO021_YYYYYY.xlsx and 55120DO002_YYYYYY.xlsx; both must share one reference year.

tables.Table_1: GG operating statement (taxation revenue, non-tax revenue, total GFS revenue)
tables.Table_4: GG expenses by purpose (COFOG-A divisions; Commonwealth table also shows public debt transactions and health/education groups)

sources.format: xlsx, ABS formatted tables; years in row 5, $m in row 6; release date in row 3

series.publicDebtTransactions: Commonwealth only: General public services > Public debt transactions

sources.discovery: Scrape latest-release page for 55060DO001_YYYYYY.xlsx and 55060DO002_YYYYYY.xlsx (formerly cat. 5506.0).

tables.55060DO002 Table_2: Total taxation revenue by sub-category, all levels (used for the all-levels receipts)
tables.55060DO001 Table_1: Taxation, Commonwealth Government by detailed tax (used for the Commonwealth receipts)

named: Taxes on employers payroll and labour force
Taxes on financial and capital transactions
series.otherTaxes: derived: total taxation less named taxes

sources.basis: GDP current prices, original; four quarters Sep..Jun summed per financial year; null unless all four quarters exist

validation: Eleven COFOG-A divisions + rounding adjustment (|x| <= item count) sum exactly to Total Expenses for every year and level.
Receipts: ABS total taxation (55060) equals GFS taxation revenue (55120 Table_1) within $2m; named taxes + other taxes = total taxation; tax + non-tax items + rounding = Total GFS revenue.

Reject non-positive totals, negative items (other than rounding), fewer than 5 years, discontinuous years, mismatched years across views, GDP shares inconsistent with the stored GDP denominators, missing Commonwealth level or incomplete source metadata.
Commonwealth public debt transactions must lie within general public services.
caveats: Only 10 years: each release is a rolling ten-year window; older releases are earlier vintages and are not spliced.
Top-level COFOG-A divisions only (no all-levels groups); Transport is a separate division.
All-levels table has no public debt transactions line, so debtInterest is omitted for the default view.
Commonwealth and all-levels figures must never be added: Commonwealth expenses include grants to states that the consolidated view nets out.
